header: Issue week in the Lisbon studio

items.slide_description: Six editors, one printed dummy and every caption checked against the paper it belongs to. Nothing moves to plates before this table agrees.
Plate checks start at 07:00 and the first clean sheets come off around 09:30. A run of 4,200 copies takes the rest of the day.
Each paper in the issue appears in the Lodestar archive with its DOI, its dataset link and the date it opens to every reader.
